How we work

A studio model built on accountability, not billable hours.

Core Guarantee

Fixed scope and guaranteed price before writing a single line of code.

We define exact deliverables, milestones, technical parameters, and delivery windows upfront. You sign off on a fixed USD budget—no surprise change orders, no unapproved invoices, and no sliding launch windows.

01

A working demo every week

You receive clickable, working software every seven days to review on your own screen—never static slide decks or status reports.

02

You approve each milestone

Progress is split into clearly defined stages. You test and approve each build before releasing payment for the next.

03

100% code and asset ownership

All source code repositories, design files, and cloud accounts are transferred to you in full. No lock-in, ever.

Three engineering disciplines. One accountable studio.

We do not farm out code to junior contractors. You communicate directly with senior software engineers delivering working software every week.

Week-by-week plan

Real milestones. Working software demonstrated every seven days.

Derived from our verified delivery timelines: Websites (4–8 weeks), Digital products (8–16 weeks), and Systems & scale (6–12 weeks).

Week 1

Architecture & technical foundation

Agreed technical specification, data schema, Figma component primitives, and deployment environments locked down.

Weeks 2–4

Core workflows & weekly demo builds

Primary user journeys, authentication, interactive screens, and database integrations delivered in verified weekly increments.

Weeks 5–8

Full integration & production launch (Websites window)

End-to-end integration, performance profiling, responsive cross-browser audits, and production launch on your domain.

Weeks 9–16

Scale telemetry & application release (Digital products window)

High-scale edge optimizations, automated mock/testing routines, Google Play store submission, and production handover.

FAQ

Everything you need to know before we build.

Websites launch in 4 to 8 weeks. Digital products and web/mobile applications launch in 8 to 16 weeks, and custom systems and scale infrastructure deploy in 6 to 12 weeks—all delivered in verified weekly working demos.

Every project receives a fixed-price USD proposal before work begins. Focused websites typically range between $4,000 and $12,000, while comprehensive MVPs, mobile applications, and high-scale systems range between $15,000 and $35,000. You know the exact number upfront—no hidden overages or surprise hourly billing.

We work in weekly increments. You test each working build and approve each milestone before the next stage begins. Invoices are in USD, settled securely via Stripe (major credit cards) or international wire transfer (ACH / SWIFT).

You own 100% of everything we build. All GitHub repositories, design systems, cloud infrastructure, and production assets are transferred to your company upon launch.

Every launch includes a 30-day post-launch warranty covering bug fixes and performance tuning. Afterwards, we offer flexible monthly engineering retainer support or a clean handoff to your internal team.

Senior product designers and full-stack software engineers actively writing your code. You communicate directly with the builders—no junior account managers or sales middlemen in between.
